name: Neo-brutalist
summary: Raw blocks, hard edges, high-contrast type, and visible structural pressure.
constraints: Use hard offset planes and heavy rules as a complete spatial system, not isolated stickers.
Use compressed or blocky display type with clear scale jumps.
Keep navigation and controls unmistakably legible inside the raw geometry.
Use one interaction snap or displacement, not constant jitter.
motion: Short stepped displacement or shadow shifts on action; no ambient wobble.
typography: Condensed grotesk with a heavy display face
layout: Hard grid, thick outlines, overlapping blocks

name: Maximal Collage
summary: Layered fragments, mixed scales, clipped typography, and controlled visual overload.
constraints: Build one readable focal route through the layers.
Use visible seams and cut edges; do not fake polish with generic cards.
Limit to a coherent set of three or four material families.
Keep every layer useful to sequence, meaning, or navigation.
motion: Layered parallax with a strict hierarchy; only one plane responds strongly.
typography: Mixed editorial serif and compact grotesk
layout: Overlapping cut-paper planes and fragmented columns

name: Kinetic Type
summary: Typography becomes the composition, sequence, and primary interaction.
constraints: Use one typographic system with deliberate scale, weight, and direction changes.
Animate reading order or meaning, never every headline at once.
Preserve a static reading state and reduced-motion equivalent.
Navigation and actions still resolve to recognizable controls.
motion: Marquee, type-on, or scroll-linked letter transforms; pause on focus.
typography: Large grotesk display with monospaced supporting copy
layout: Type-led diagonal rails and composed negative space

name: Retro-futurist
summary: Interface fiction, instrument panels, luminous terminals, and analog-future detail.
constraints: Use one coherent future instrument language across chrome and data.
Keep terminal and instrument references functional, not disguises.
Use glow as emitted light with a stable source and falloff.
Provide ordinary navigation and form behavior alongside the fiction.
motion: Scan, cursor, and status transitions must be sparse and state-bound.
typography: Technical monospace with a narrow display grotesk
layout: Control-room grid, instrument bays, and ruled telemetry

name: Spatial Generative
summary: Depth, procedural geometry, light fields, and a singular spatial mechanism.
constraints: Use one spatial mechanism that communicates the product rather than generic floating shapes.
Keep text and controls on a legible plane independent of motion.
Provide static and reduced-motion states with the same information.
Budget GPU and frame time; degrade geometry before removing meaning.
motion: Camera drift or constructive motion tied to scroll and state; never constant orbiting.
typography: High-contrast sans with tabular technical labels
layout: Central luminous field surrounded by calm semantic structure

name: Narrative Scroll
summary: A paced story where composition, media, and scrolling reveal a mechanism.
constraints: Give each scroll chapter one idea, one visual state, and one outcome.
Use sticky or staged composition only when sequence carries meaning.
Provide non-scroll navigation and a readable static fallback.
Do not hide essential proof or actions behind the narrative effect.
motion: Scroll-linked scene progression with visible chapter state; ensure reduced-motion equivalence.
typography: Editorial display serif with compact sans captions
layout: Chaptered vertical journey with one anchored object

name: Signal Glitch
summary: Controlled interruption, chromatic offsets, scanning, and high-tech instability.
constraints: Keep the base layout stable while one signal layer disrupts it.
Glitch state must not reduce text legibility or control certainty.
Use transition bursts around events rather than perpetual noise.
Respect reduced motion and avoid flashing beyond accessibility limits.
motion: Event-triggered displacement and scan bursts; never continuous high-frequency flicker.
typography: Condensed grotesk with monospaced status text
layout: Stable grid cut by one displaced signal layer

name: Character-led
summary: A distinctive illustrated character or creature guides meaning and interaction.
constraints: The character must reveal product meaning or interaction, never act as decorative clip art.
Keep one coherent illustration grammar and a printable silhouette.
Text, controls, and state remain usable without the character.
Use character motion for feedback or guidance, not constant distraction.
motion: Small reaction loops tied to completion, errors, or guidance; rest at idle.
typography: Rounded display sans with a sturdy text sans
layout: Character-led composition with speech and action as visual material
